description: Glass camera after the view change found on 2026-11-19 (tilted down / panned right). Vertical count line just left of the tactile paving at the plaza/stairs boundary. Foot ROI excludes the far fence area and everything above the glass-railing foot (reflections). Only right-to-left passages are counted (count_directions); line position x=0.45-0.65 gave the same rtl counts on two validation clips (27/27 and 47-50 vs ~48), 0.55 is the middle of that stable range.
